name: action-repeat-4
source:
---- MODULE Differential ----
EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLE x
A0(v) == x'=v
A1(v) == A0(v) \/ A0(v)
A2(v) == A1(v) \/ A1(v)
A3(v) == A2(v) \/ A2(v)
A4(v) == A3(v) \/ A3(v)
Init == x=0
Next == A4((x+1)%4)
====
config:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE

name: action-capture
source:
---- MODULE Differential ----
EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLE x
Init == x=0
Next == \E delta \in {1,2}: LET Step(v) == x'=(x+delta+v)%4 IN Step(0) \/ Step(0) \/ Step(0) \/ Step(0)
====

INIT Init
NEXT Next
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE

name: temporal-repeat-3
source:

EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLE x
T0(limit) == [](x<limit)
T1(limit) == T0(limit) /\ T0(limit)
T2(limit) == T1(limit) /\ T1(limit)
T3(limit) == T2(limit) /\ T2(limit)
Init == x=0
Next == x'=(x+1)%4
Live == T3(4)
====

NEXT Next
PROPERTY Live

name: lazy-control
source:
---- MODULE Differential ----
EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLE x
F[i \in 0..15] == IF i=0 THEN 1 ELSE IF i=1 THEN 1 \div 0 ELSE F[0]
Alias == F
Id(f) == f
Init == x=0
Next == x'=(x+Id(Alias)[0])%4
====
config:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
